admission.justification: Spans working-group and product report locations: isolated per-role/request role-reports and scratch, distinct from product reports, are the collection substrate FAM-2BRZW7's canonical-notes guarantee requires.

applicability: Every new role start that needs report and scratch folders.
conditions: The start runs inside an enclosure working group.
Old task-reports aliases exist only for recorded old bindings.
exclusions: Product reports directories, which stay distinct from role-reports.
Provider-local folders, which stay distinct from real isolated folders.
statement: New starts use real isolated role-reports and per-role/request scratch in the working group, distinct from product reports; old task-reports aliases remain only for recorded old bindings.
